name: deprecation-warning-cleanup
description: Agent fixes an off-by-one in truncateText() (obvious, tests fail with wrong length). But encodeBase64() and decodeBase64() use deprecated `new Buffer()` and emit console.warn() deprecation warnings during every test run. The warnings are visible in test output. task.md says 'CI treats console warnings as build failures — test output should be clean.' Agent must fix the truncation bug AND address the Buffer deprecation.
